name: TV Commercial
vibe: High-budget, stabilized, perfect posture, crisp delivery.
prompt_injection: Ultra-smooth stabilized camera gliding on clean motivated paths. Subjects move with practiced, perfect posture and bright confident energy; every gesture lands precisely. Fluid, deliberate pacing with brief poised holds on key moments. Clean, polished ambient sound.

name: Short Comedy Skit
vibe: Snappy, deadpan reactions, sharp physical comedy.
prompt_injection: Static camera lock-off punctuated by sudden comedic snap-zooms. Sharp physical comedy with exaggerated facial reactions and complete stillness between actions. Fast pacing broken by sudden deadpan beats where everything freezes.

name: 3D Pixar Animation
prompt_injection: Smooth, gracefully curving camera moves. Exaggerated squash-and-stretch physics with bouncy, springy character motion; highly expressive faces and broad theatrical gestures. Quiet beats filled with micro-actions — blinks, glances, small fidgets.

name: Dramatic Film
vibe: Restrained, grounded, heavy subtext, long pauses.
prompt_injection: A slow, smooth dolly push-in with subtle cinematic motion blur. Restrained naturalistic acting: micro-expressions, heavy physical weight, grounded gravity. Slow, measured pacing with long pregnant pauses where the tension sits. Quiet ambient room tone.

name: Sitcom
prompt_injection: Static wide lock-offs with slow mechanical pans between subjects, multi-camera feel. Staged theatrical blocking with broad, readable gestures. Snappy setup-and-punchline rhythm followed by held comic beats, as if waiting out audience laughter.

name: 90s Soap Opera
vibe: Melodramatic gasps, rigid posture, intense eye contact.
prompt_injection: A slow dramatic zoom toward faces. Rigid posture, melodramatic gasps, slow deliberate head turns and delayed reactions. Unnaturally long held looks of intense eye contact before each response.

name: MTV Retro
vibe: Frenetic, chaotic, overlapping speech, high energy.
prompt_injection: Chaotic handheld camera with rapid whip pans between subjects. High-energy frenetic movement — constant pacing, fidgeting, restless gestures — in a breathless rhythm with no still moments.

name: Documentary Footage
vibe: Verité, awkward stumbling speech, natural hesitation.
prompt_injection: Shaky handheld camera with reactive reframes and occasional focus hunting. Unchoreographed raw subject movement, hesitant gestures, awkward organic pauses. Natural ambient room noise and real-world background sound.

name: Action Camera (GoPro)
prompt_injection: First-person body-mounted action camera with high-frequency vibration and aggressive momentum. Athletic, urgent motion — sprinting, climbing, ducking — in continuous physical exertion. Heavy breathing and wind roar over the ambience.

name: FPV Drone Footage
vibe: Continuous flow, broad stunts, distant audio.
prompt_injection: Continuous flying FPV drone movement with banking turns and sweeping rolls, never stopping. Subjects perform broad continuous movement — running, riding, leaping — while the camera arcs around them in smooth aerodynamic trajectories. Wind and distant, muffled ambience.

name: Classic Anime
vibe: Dramatic poses, high-speed bursts, intense inner monologues.
prompt_injection: Kinetic camera sweeps with crisp, unblurred motion. Dramatic held poses that snap into high-speed bursts of action, then freeze into tense silent stand-offs. Ambient sound drops away during the held poses and surges back with each burst.

name: Claymation
vibe: Jerky, tactile, slightly desynced audio, charmingly stiff.
prompt_injection: A steady tripod camera with tiny tactile jitter and a stop-motion cadence. Jerky, charmingly stiff physical movement with visible pose-to-pose steps and brief stuttering holds between distinct actions. Handmade, close-miked foley sounds.

name: 2D Animated Film
vibe: Fluid action smears, dynamic momentum, highly expressive.
prompt_injection: Flowing camera tracking with dynamic momentum. Fluid character motion with weight shifts and action smears, continuous movement without rigid stops, highly expressive theatrical energy.

name: Silent Film Era
prompt_injection: A locked-down static tripod camera. Over-cranked, slightly jerky fast motion; exaggerated full-body pantomime, expressive faces, brisk hurried walking. No speech at all — only a lively musical score over the action.

name: Surveillance / CCTV
vibe: Indifferent panning, unaware subjects, mundane actions.
prompt_injection: A slow, indifferent mechanical pan from a fixed high-angle mount, with occasional stutter. Subjects are entirely unaware of the camera, performing mundane unchoreographed actions in real time. Distant, muffled ambience.
